from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
import os

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = Inches(13.333)
prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)

# 定义颜色常量
COLOR_PRIMARY = RGBColor(0x1A, 0x3C, 0x6E)
COLOR_SECONDARY = RGBColor(0x2E, 0x86, 0xAB)
COLOR_ACCENT = RGBColor(0x17, 0xA2, 0xB8)
COLOR_BG = RGBColor(0xF0, 0xF4, 0xF8)

def add_background(slide, color=COLOR_BG):
    background = slide.background
    fill = background.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color

def add_title_textbox(slide, text, left, top, width, height, font_size=40, bold=True, color=COLOR_PRIMARY):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.LEFT
    return txBox

def add_bullet_textbox(slide, items, left, top, width, height, font_size=18, color=COLOR_PRIMARY):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, item in enumerate(items):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = item
        p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.space_after = Pt(8)
    return txBox

# === 封面 ===
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])  # blank
add_background(slide, COLOR_PRIMARY)
add_title_textbox(slide, "Agent 技术深度报告", Inches(1), Inches(1.5), Inches(11), Inches(1.5),
                 font_size=52, bold=True, color=RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF))
add_title_textbox(slide, "从概念到实践：AI 自主智能体的现状与未来", Inches(1), Inches(3.5), Inches(11), Inches(1),
                 font_size=28, bold=False, color=RGBColor(0xCC, 0xDD, 0xFF))
add_title_textbox(slide, "2024年12月  |  Claude 生成", Inches(1), Inches(5.5), Inches(5), Inches(1),
                 font_size=16, bold=False, color=RGBColor(0xAA, 0xBB, 0xDD))

# === 目录 ===
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
add_background(slide)
add_title_textbox(slide, "目  录", Inches(1), Inches(0.5), Inches(5), Inches(1),
                 font_size=36, bold=True, color=COLOR_PRIMARY)
items = [
    "1. 什么是 Agent？—— 核心定义与特点",
    "2. Agent 架构详解 —— 感知-思考-行动循环",
    "3. 主流框架与工具 —— LangChain, AutoGPT, CrewAI",
    "4. 关键技术 —— 规划、记忆、工具使用、多智能体协作",
    "5. 应用案例 —— 编程、研究、自动化、客服",
    "6. 挑战与局限 —— 幻觉、安全、成本、可解释性",
    "7. 未来展望 —— Agent 原生应用与超级智能体",

add_background(slide)

items = [
